title: Multi-Omics Profiling Redefines Age-Related Hearing Loss as a Systemic Aging Sentinel: A Molecular Taxonomy and Precision Intervention Framework Anchored in …

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract asserts multi-omics analysis but names no countable molecular layer: epigenetic aging is an aging construct rather than an epigenomics measurement, and the truncated singular “protein358” does not establish proteomics.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This appears to report current multi-omics analyses of an aging-related health phenotype. Aging is analyzed as epigenetic aging, but the thin, truncated text does not resolve two distinct molecular omics layers.

causal_design_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract asserts a directional result but does not describe an applied causal or directed design or an assessable contrast.
causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: Current-report analysis and directional wording are stated, but the applied method is too thin to classify.
